about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a Full Stack developer specialized in Angular and Java. I work on modernizing banking platforms, where I leverage AI to accelerate legacy code migrations and generate technical documentation more efficiently.
about.paragraph2: I like to understand software beyond the code: from how it reaches production to how the end user experiences it. In my free time, I tinker with Python, cloud infrastructure, and whatever sparks my curiosity.

portfolio.title: Portfolio

project1.title: yoelvilla.dev
project1.description: Personal portfolio with serverless architecture. Frontend deployed on S3 + CloudFront, backend with Lambda + API Gateway. Custom translation system, personalized cursor and integrated contact form.

project2.title: Route Designer
project2.description: Mountain route planner and analyzer. Track editor with topographic layers, DEM-based elevation profiling and automatic slope analysis. Frontend deployed on Cloudflare Workers and backend on Railway with SQLite cache and rate limiting.

portfolio.experience1: Angular/Java Developer at Métrica (May 2025 - Present): Banking platform modernization for Santander. Migration of Informix 4GL legacy systems to modern architectures with Spring Boot and Angular. AI-assisted analysis and legacy code refactoring.
portfolio.experience2: Angular Developer at IRM Analytics (May 2024 - May 2025): Development of interactive dashboards for complex data analysis. Implementation of Web Workers and IndexedDB for optimized large-scale data processing. Advanced visualizations with D3.js, Sigma.js and interactive maps.
